notes.title: Patch Notes 2
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug where Steam couldn't run the game from the previous patch notes.  Oopsie!
 - Fixed a bug where the main menu screen would be frozen after quitting to the main menu.
 - Fixed a bug where the player couldn't increase the volume of the music during a run.
 - Made the win room more clear that you've won.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1
notes.notes:
- Fixed the sawblade object to now function properly.
- The Slice of Ages now spawns in the chest room after the final boss.
